title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette and pattern fills to the Session 3 app
body:
## Problem
The Session 3 app uses green and red for pass and fail; some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette or hatch pattern plus the words PASSES or FAILS that stays distinguishable in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Pass and fail distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: a cantilever wall with a heel slab
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. Students ask how real walls use less concrete than the rectangular wall of Session 3.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add passive resistance at the toe to the sliding check
body:
## Problem
Session 3 neglects passive resistance, so narrow walls look worse than they are.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 2. Passive pressure uses Kp = tan^2(45 + phi/2) and is usually only partly relied on.

## Expected outcome
A function and a lesson that add a passive force with a stated reduction factor and compare with the Session 3 results.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Passive force checked against a hand calculation
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: the wall as the water level rises
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows the wall, the pressure diagram and the safety factors as the backfill floods; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Animation shows the cross-section, force arrows, pressure diagram and both safety factors
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
